panels.title: Cabber operations RPS (gateway)
panels.description: One line per operation of the published contract. A rate is reported only while the gateway was scraped through the whole window, so a restart does not read as a drop in traffic.

targets.expr: sum by (operation) (rate(cabby_gateway_cabber_requests_total[1m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[1m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[1m]) >= 4))

panels.title: Rejection share by operation
panels.description: Every answer that is not a success: a rejected request, a taken address, a refused access, an unavailable dependency. A share that jumps without traffic behind it is a client bug, not an attack.

targets.expr: sum by (operation) (rate(cabby_gateway_cabber_requests_total{outcome!="success"}[5m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) >= 4)) / sum by (operation) (rate(cabby_gateway_cabber_requests_total[5m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) >= 4))

panels.title: Refused accesses per second (brute-force indicator)
panels.description: unauthorized is the one outcome a client cannot produce by mistake at volume: wrong credentials and dead or foreign accesses land here (FR-012, FR-016, SC-006). A rising line with no matching traffic is a guessing attempt.

targets.expr: sum by (operation) (rate(cabby_gateway_cabber_requests_total{outcome="unauthorized"}[5m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="cabby-gateway"}[5m]) >= 4))

sum by (method) (rate(cabby_auth_requests_total{outcome="unauthorized"}[5m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="auth"}[5m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="auth"}[5m]) >= 4))

panels.title: Gateway to auth delay (p50, p95)
panels.description: The gRPC call alone, timed by the gateway around one operation (R-11). The deadline of a call is 2 s, so a p95 near it means callers are about to see 503.

panels.title: Inside auth: request delay (p50, p95)
panels.description: What the service measured for itself, so the gap to the gateway panel is the network and what the service adds beyond the storage. A login derives a password hash and pays for it: the latency target of plan.md is read here.

panels.title: Storage queries failing per second
panels.description: Only a failed query or a lost connection is counted as a failure: a taken address and a missing row are correct answers. auth reports no duration of a query, so this is the delay of the storage as far as it is observable in v1 (R-11).

targets.expr: sum by (query) (rate(cabby_auth_repository_query_total{outcome="failure"}[5m]) and on(job,instance) (min_over_time(up{job="auth"}[5m]) == 1) and on(job,instance) (count_over_time(up{job="auth"}[5m]) >= 4))

panels.title: Services reachable
panels.description: The unavailability a client sees as 503 starts here: neither service answers without the other, and auth answers nothing without its storage.
